proposition_text: A person must not spread organic manure within 10 metres of surface water, except where permitted by specific exceptions.
label: Prohibition on spreading organic manure within 10 metres of surface water
affected_subjects: organic manure within 10 metres of surface water
notes: Core prohibition with clear exceptions cross-referenced to later paragraphs.
review_notes: Core prohibition with clear exceptions cross-referenced to later paragraphs.

extraction_debug_meta.display_label: Prohibition on spreading organic manure within 10 metres of surface water

proposition_text: Livestock manure (other than slurry or poultry manure) may be spread on land managed for breeding wader birds or species-rich semi-natural grassland that is notified as SSSI or subject to agri-environmental commitment, during 1st June to 31st October, not directly on surface water, and not exceeding 12.5 tonnes per hectare annually.
label: Exception for livestock manure on designated land
short_name: Livestock manure (other than slurry or poultry manure) may be spread
legal_subject: Livestock manure (other than slurry or poultry manure)
conditions: land comes within paragraph (3) (notified SSSI or agri-environmental commitment)
spread in the period that begins with 1st June and ends with the following 31st October
not spread directly on to surface water
total annual amount does not exceed 12.5 tonnes per hectare
affected_subjects: on land managed for breeding wader birds or as a species-rich semi-natural grassland
notes: Exception with four cumulative conditions clearly enumerated in subparagraphs (a)-(d).
review_notes: Exception with four cumulative conditions clearly enumerated in subparagraphs (a)-(d).

proposition_text: Land is designated for the livestock manure exception if it is notified as a site of special scientific interest under the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981.
label: Designated land: SSSI notification
short_name: Land comes within this paragraph if it is

proposition_text: Land is designated for the livestock manure exception if it is subject to an agri-environmental commitment entered into under Council Regulation (EC) 1698/2005 or Regulation (EU) 1305/2013.

short_name: Land comes within this paragraph if it is

proposition_text: Organic manure in the form of slurry, sewage sludge or anaerobic digestate may be spread except within 6 metres of surface water if the spreading equipment is a trailing hose band spreader, a trailing shoe band spreader, an injector injecting no deeper than 10cm, or a dribble bar applicator.

exception: within 6 metres of surface water
notes: Exception with equipment conditions enumerated in subparagraphs (a)-(c) and a 6-metre buffer.

proposition_text: Anaerobic digestate means the product of anaerobic digestion other than from sewage or material in a landfill.
label: Definition of anaerobic digestate
affected_subjects: the product of anaerobic digestion other than from sewage or material in a landfill

proposition_text: A person must not spread organic manure within 50 metres of a borehole, spring or well.
label: Prohibition on spreading organic manure within 50 metres of water sources
affected_subjects: organic manure within 50 metres of a borehole, spring or well

proposition_text: The regulation on spreading organic manure does not apply to land which is covered by a greenhouse.
